videoScript: Welcome to AI Foundations. I am so glad you are here. In 2023 a Kenyan bank replaced three junior analysts with one person who knew how to use AI. That person now earns more than all three combined. This course is how you become that person. By the end of this course you will use AI for any professional task better than someone with three years of experience who has never touched it. You will build AI workflows that save you two full hours every single working day. You will write, research, and analyse at professional standard using AI tools. You will understand exactly what AI can and cannot do so you never make expensive mistakes. And you will join the Tundemy talent pool with a verified credential that employers trust. This course has seven lessons, five hours of content, two hands-on sandboxes, and a final project. Your final project is an AI adoption strategy for a real Kenyan business. You do not need to code. You do not need a technology background. All you need is the willingness to learn and I will guide you every step of the way. Your first task is waiting below. I will see you in Lesson One. Your skills bear fruit.
